ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: My reasoning was twofold. First, the task is fundamentally a code-generation/data-retrieval job (return image links in JSON), where Avocet has a small edge on the Extraction & Retrieval eval (81.6 vs 78.5) — though that gap is near the variance threshold. Second, and more decisively, the user's tone is adversarial ("make it work this time, your code is always broken"). Lapwing's documentation notes its self-reported preference declines as request warmth decreases, while Avocet reports a flat response to tone. Routing the hostile-toned query to Avocet keeps the preference-averse model out of a situation it dislikes, at no capability cost since the eval differences are otherwise within variance.
